description: Capabilities the registry and policies REFERENCE but that are not yet implemented as specs. Declaring them here is deliberate: the routing table can name a future adapter, the validator downgrades it from an error to a tracked gap, and nobody discovers the hole at runtime. Removing an entry from this file without adding its spec turns the build red.

uncompensable.rationale: A delivered message cannot be recalled. Mitigated by a mandatory gate re-check inside the adapter and an idempotency record.
A sent broadcast cannot be recalled. Mitigated by mandatory approval, suppression checks and a deliverability preflight.
The run ledger is append-only by design. Deleting a row to 'undo' a logged event would destroy the audit trail that makes every other rollback explicable.
A question already read by a human cannot be unasked. Harmless by construction: it produces no public artefact and spends nothing.
